#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int countV, countK, countS;
vector<vector<int>> freqTable;
vector<vector<int>> indexLists(3);
vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> cache;

int compute(int v, int k, int s, int last) {
    if (v == countV && k == countK && s == countS) return 0;
    if (cache[v][k][s][last] != -1) return cache[v][k][s][last];
    int result = INT_MAX;
    if (v < countV) {
        int p = indexLists[0][v];
        int cost = max(freqTable[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freqTable[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freqTable[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        result = min(result, compute(v + 1, k, s, 0) + cost);
    }
    if (k < countK && last != 0) {
        int p = indexLists[1][k];
        int cost = max(freqTable[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freqTable[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freqTable[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        result = min(result, compute(v, k + 1, s, 1) + cost);
    }
    if (s < countS) {
        int p = indexLists[2][s];
        int cost = max(freqTable[p][0] - v, 0) + max(freqTable[p][1] - k, 0) + max(freqTable[p][2] - s, 0) - 1;
        result = min(result, compute(v, k, s + 1, 2) + cost);
    }
    return cache[v][k][s][last] = result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string inputStr;
    cin >> inputStr;
    vector<char> chars(inputStr.begin(), inputStr.end());

    countV = countK = countS = 0;
    freqTable.assign(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));
    indexLists.assign(3, vector<int>());
    int position = 0;

    for (char ch : chars) {
        if (position > 0) {
            freqTable[position] = freqTable[position - 1];
        }
        if (ch == 'V') {
            freqTable[position][0]++;
            countV++;
            indexLists[0].push_back(position);
        } else if (ch == 'K') {
            freqTable[position][1]++;
            countK++;
            indexLists[1].push_back(position);
        } else {
            freqTable[position][2]++;
            countS++;
            indexLists[2].push_back(position);
        }
        position++;
    }

    cache.assign(countV + 1, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(
        countK + 1, vector<vector<int>>(
            countS + 1, vector<int>(4, -1)
        )
    ));

    cout << compute(0, 0, 0, 2) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
